description:
What's so great about managing the Jianghu (river and lake) world? We, the pinnacle of gods and demons, secretly join hands, and when our heads grow uncomfortably, we help each other sort out our differences by lending a helping hand, and that's it. So-called peaceful Jiang-Hu, we leave a great mark on the history of Jiang-Hu, and each family and bloodline lays the foundation for a thousand years of glory and power. A liaison for each other? They're just expendable items. We make them dream for a while, and when their purpose is over, we discard them. A man and a woman cross the line on the verge of killing the rabbit and cooking the dog. The small ripples they create become a storm and sweep through the peaceful Jianghu.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
